tools.name: PIEStudio.replay_run

steps.description: Inline step array (alternative to a recording)

capture_frame_every.description: Capture a viewport frame every N steps (keeps JPEG frames + builds a contact sheet)

tools.name: PIEStudio.replay_analyze

recording_dir.description: Recording folder (used directly when no id is given)

recording_dir.description: Recording folder (used directly when no id is given)

at_time.description: Seconds to sample (interpolated). Omit for the last frame

at_frame.description: Frame index to sample (alternative to at_time)

apply.description: Teleport the live PIE pawn to the recorded pose (default false)

tools.name: PIEStudio.test_scaffold
tools.description: Turn a recording into a durable, self-verifying test.json: max-drift/error assertions plus an auto-derived predicates block (range invariants per channel, montage-plays events, no-errors). Edit predicates into intent, then run with test_run.

recording_dir.description: Recording folder (used directly when no id is given)

max_errors.description: Assertion: max errors logged during the run (default 0)

tools.name: PIEStudio.test_run
tools.description: Run a scaffolded reproduction test: replays the recording (auto_run) then checks the finalised drift.json + error count against the assertions AND evaluates the scenario's predicates over the recorded series. Returns passed + failures + a predicates verdict + artifacts.

recording_id.description: Recording id (with name) to locate the test

recording_dir.description: Recording folder to locate the test

auto_run.description: Drive the replay if no drift.json exists yet (default true)

tools.name: PIEStudio.assert_eval
tools.description: Assertion layer: evaluate predicates over a finalised run's per-frame series (observation.csv/recording.csv) + session_errors.json + markers. Each assertion binds a channel or event to an operator under a temporal quantifier (hold). Returns a verdict with, per assertion, passed + a witness frame/time/value + contact sheet. Writes verdict.json. Predicate schema: {name, channel|event, op(eq|ne|lt|lte|gt|gte|approx|between|changed|increased|decreased|crossed), value|min+max|tol, hold(always|never|eventually|at_end|once_then_always), from_s/from_frame/to_s/to_frame, within_s/within_frames, after_event{marker}, severity(error|warn)}. Channels: series columns (pos_z, speed2d, game_ms), tracked values by path (Boss.Health -> t:Boss.Health), pseudo-channels $errors/$warnings/$frame/$time. Events: montage{montage,phase}, marker{marker}, error{category,contains}.

run_id.description: Observation run id (resolves observation.csv under output_dir)

csv_path.description: Explicit per-frame series CSV (overrides run resolution)

assertions.description: Predicate objects to evaluate (see description). Omit to use test_path's predicates.

test_path.description: Scenario json to read the predicates block from, when assertions is omitted

tools.name: PIEStudio.test_list
tools.description: List scaffolded reproduction tests (all recordings, or one when recording_id/dir is given).

tools.name: PIEStudio.record_diff

tools.name: PIEStudio.snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot a PIE actor's full UProperty state to JSON

recording_id.description: Store under this recording's snapshots/ dir

tools.name: PIEStudio.actor_spawn
tools.description: Spawn an actor in the live PIE world so an agent can Arrange a scenario. Returns a stable id (usable as target for actor_set/call/destroy and snapshot).

class.description: Class path: native class or blueprint '/Game/.../BP_X.BP_X_C' (required)

tools.name: PIEStudio.actor_destroy
tools.description: Destroy a live PIE actor by id.

tools.name: PIEStudio.actor_set
tools.description: Set a UProperty on a live PIE actor by dotted path (Component.Struct.Property), coerced through ImportText. This is the write half of snapshot's reflection read.

path.description: Dotted property path, e.g. Health or Movement.MaxWalkSpeed (required)

tools.name: PIEStudio.actor_call
tools.description: Invoke a callable UFUNCTION on a live PIE actor, importing args positionally into its parameters.

args.description: Positional arguments, coerced into the function's parameters

tools.name: PIEStudio.scenario_scaffold
tools.description: Generate a declarative scenario.json (arrange/act/assert) from a recording: empty arrange, a replay act step, and starter assert predicates derived from the series. Edit into intent, then scenario_validate. The reusable, git-committable test unit.

recording_dir.description: Recording/observation folder (used directly when no id is given)

tools.name: PIEStudio.scenario_validate
tools.description: Validate a scenario's structure and predicates without running it: known arrange/act step kinds, required per-kind fields, and every assert entry parsing as a valid predicate. Returns valid + per-problem errors + step counts. Act supports replay | inject_tape | drive | goto | face | follow | call; a 'call' act step is a TIMED gameplay UFUNCTION ({at_seconds, target, component?, func, args?}) and is checked for target/func like arrange's, because a mistyped timed step otherwise fails by silently never firing.

session.description: Session id under Saved/MCPSessions (default: live/most-recent in memory)

tools.name: PIEStudio.capture
tools.description: Grab N viewport frames from the live PIE session now (decoupled from replay). Writes JPEGs plus a labeled contact sheet and returns their paths. Use to make observe/inject flows visual.

every.description: Grab one frame every N rendered frames (default 1)

contact_sheet.description: Also compose a labeled grid montage (default true)
